description: blueteam.brand's rules for fabric-pr arm. The repository has no code and no build: it is BlueTeam OÜ's brand source of authority, and the other repositories copy its machine-read files at a pinned commit. boundary.paths: those files, which every consumer takes verbatim into its own build (brand/tokens.css, the design tokens, and brand/assets/fonts/, the vendored font files), the harness wiring (.claude/: settings and hooks), CI and package manifests should the repository ever grow them (.github/, package.json and lockfiles), and words where the boundary is a file anywhere (secret, credential, token, key, auth). boundary.exempt is dropped first, but never under .claude/: Markdown, which is the brand guide, the claims and the decision records' prose, and .agent-fabric/. No classes. waiver_role is null: only the owner waives the boundary. No direct-to-main rule: every change is a pull request (the repository's README).
